threat_event: Phishing of tax office staff leads to mailbox takeover and theft of client documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Office intake mailboxes accept legacy authentication; no inbox-rule alerts for tax offices; client documents in email
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G4 office mailboxes; SYS-S1 Tax tenant
existing_controls: Number-matching MFA for named users; email gateway; phishing exercises
treatment_plan: Block legacy authentication; tax office inbox-rule alerts; move intake to portal upload
owner: Tax division security and compliance lead

threat_event: A fraudulent refund bank-account change diverts a client's refund
threat_source: Fraudsters using hijacked email or stolen identities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call-back rule not followed in 11 of 60 sampled changes
treatment_plan: SYS-T1 blocks release until the call-back is recorded; weekly review of bank-field changes

threat_event: The referral interface sends tax return information before the client's consent is recorded
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No consent check in the interface; CRM flag set by coordinators
treatment_plan: Interface reads the consent register before every transfer

threat_event: Consents do not cover the products solicited, and Wealth uses statistical compilations of tax return information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2022 template says "financial planning and investment services"; analytics built from referral fields
treatment_plan: New template naming each type of product or service; re-consent; stop compilations

threat_event: Seasonal accounts are active before screening and training and stay active after the season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bulk provisioning; office-manager extensions without HR events
treatment_plan: Gate activation on screening and training; expire accounts on the HR end date

threat_event: A seasonal employee steals client identities for refund fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad office access in season; screening gaps
existing_controls: Background checks; office-scoped roles; PTIN monitoring
treatment_plan: Bulk-access analytics; screening before access
owner: Tax division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Office managers browse returns across their region without a need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Regional read access for 1,150 office managers
treatment_plan: Office-only access; time-limited regional access on request

threat_event: AI extraction errors reach filed returns
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accuracy monitoring by document type; photographed documents
existing_controls: Preparer and reviewer checks; field-level source links
treatment_plan: Monthly accuracy and bias sampling; mandatory verification of critical fields

threat_event: The AI drafting assistant proposes tax positions without IRC 7216 and Circular 230 review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot enabled without the AI standard review
existing_controls: Pilot limited to 300 preparers; reviewer sign-off
treatment_plan: Complete the review; restrict to in-house model use with no disclosure outside the firm

threat_event: A breach at the AI-001 model provider exposes source documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Documents with SSNs sent to a hosted model
treatment_plan: Annual assurance review; deletion attestation
owner: Tax division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts SYS-T1 in the filing season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Season volume; 1,150 offices
treatment_plan: Restore test at season volume; office segmentation

threat_event: Malware on an office workstation captures preparer credentials or documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared office workstations in season
treatment_plan: Kiosk mode for seasonal workstations
owner: Tax division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Password spraying against office intake mailboxes succeeds through legacy authentication
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2019 exception for 1,150 mailboxes
treatment_plan: Block legacy authentication; retire intake mailboxes

threat_event: The e-file gateway fails near a deadline and failover does not work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Failover untested at season volume
treatment_plan: Failover test at season volume before 2027-01-15

threat_event: A payroll SaaS outage halts payroll for 21,000 client businesses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single payroll vendor
existing_controls: Vendor SOC reports; daily payroll register exports
treatment_plan: Payroll contingency plan with repeat-run procedure

threat_event: A business email compromise changes a client employee's direct deposit in payroll
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Change requests accepted by email
treatment_plan: Changes only through the client portal with client approval

threat_event: Fraudulent returns are filed under a firm EFIN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weekly EFIN and PTIN monitoring in place
treatment_plan: Keep the weekly checks; add off-season monthly checks

threat_event: Client portal accounts are taken over by credential stuffing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mandatory client MFA since 2025-12
treatment_plan: Monitor MFA fatigue patterns

threat_event: The tax engine vendor's transmitter is unavailable near a deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No second transmitter
treatment_plan: Accepted: returns queue and release in bulk; extensions as fallback

threat_event: Client files past the 7-year retention schedule are exposed in a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Purge jobs not running in the archive tier
treatment_plan: Run purge jobs; annual review

threat_event: Paper documents or printer-scanner drives in offices are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shredding and drive overwrite at lease end
treatment_plan: Verify overwrite certificates for all leased devices

threat_event: A hurricane closes Florida offices near the October 15 deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 21% of individual clients in Florida
existing_controls: Cloud hosting outside Florida; other offices can take work
treatment_plan: Office relocation plan; early extensions

threat_event: CPA Partners engagement files, including outside service organizations' SOC examination workpapers, are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engagement-team access; group services not documented
treatment_plan: Document inheritance; annual access review by engagement
owner: CPA Partners risk and quality partner

threat_event: CPA Partners cannot show HIPAA safeguards for PHI it holds as a business associate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No inheritance documentation; administrative services agreement lacks subcontractor terms for PHI
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-T3; about 85 health care audit engagements
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix; subcontractor terms with the holding company for PHI
owner: CPA Partners risk and quality partner

threat_event: CPA Partners staff follow the 2023 supplement instead of 2026 group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supplement not aligned
treatment_plan: Re-issue the supplement
owner: CPA Partners risk and quality partner

threat_event: An encrypted laptop is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes data unreadable
owner: Tax division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Bank feed connector credentials for client accounting are compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Read-only aggregator tokens
treatment_plan: Token inventory review

threat_event: A return is delivered to the wrong client in the portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual folder assignment in offices
treatment_plan: Automated client-matching check

threat_event: A contractor maintaining the tax engine accesses return data without the IRC 7216 written notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notices given through PS-7; few contractors
existing_controls: Written notices; PAM for vendor access
treatment_plan: Annual notice refresh

threat_event: An IRS data theft report is not made by the next business day after confirmation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group playbooks lack the IRS step; office managers unaware
treatment_plan: Add the IRS step to the combined matrix; tabletop
